limitations: This is author verification, not independent source review or human business/legal acceptance.
No trusted continuation flag exists in MaterialBlock. The finite heuristic does not solve arbitrary OCR/layout, and unproven continuation stays unavailable.
A page boundary only stops lexical synthesis. Existing source_relation_unresolved and other review issues may remain; no fact is automatically confirmed.
Read-time review retains historical review warnings and old null amounts; the change does not erase prior stored warnings or automatically upgrade old unavailable extractions.
